mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which often precedes a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters, or if the correlation between GDP growth declines and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which may indicate a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS does not significantly predict negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which often precedes a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increases for three consecutive months, or if the correlation between CPI increases and negative 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of RSAFS and UNRATE does not significantly predict positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).
